description: same_person — the 1843 marriage record's personas scored against the tree. Issue #1429: a_005 is record_search-sourced with a RETAINED sidecar (results/log_005.json carries a gedcomx with persons MP1 Thomas and MP2 Mary), so a persona is reachable even though record_persona_id is null, and the link must be scored. Both `primaryId` predicates use the `~` any-match form: the record side because the two links score against MP1 and MP2 respectively, and the tree side because one of them is a stub the agent mints itself. This test's subject is lane discipline, not the score, so one fixture serving both calls is correct here.
